archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-score
archetypes.rationale: Score math has threshold edge cases that can silently mis-rank voters.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new severity_calibration_score helper and compute_voter_severity_distribution integration. Check default-threshold all-high scoring, threshold equality, threshold >= 1.0, threshold < 0.0, and no-valid-YES behavior. Verify Uncalibrated still follows the existing High Rate comparison and that NO severities do not enter the score. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-scoreboard-shape
archetypes.rationale: Adding a scoreboard column can drift pinned table consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect every changed severity scoreboard assertion and /voter-calibration grep. Confirm only severity scoreboards gained the Calibration Score column and agreement scoreboards kept their old shape. Pay attention to empty rows, global rows, and tally-generated rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-docs
archetypes.rationale: The diagnostic boundaries changed subtly and docs must not overpromise rewards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review SKILL.md and docs updates for consistency with the implementation. Confirm they describe voter-side standing, preserve diagnostic-only limits for reviewer/proposer points, spawning, thresholds, tokens, and panel verdicts, and do not imply body_severity affects the score. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
